stem:
Tanya draws two lines that meet at a point. All four angles at that meeting are equal.

What can she conclude?

options.text: Each angle is a right angle, and that label alone is the full conclusion.
The lines are perpendicular even when they stay apart and never meet.
The lines are perpendicular, because four equal angles at an intersection are each $90^\circ$.
The lines are perpendicular because the printed word equal is the standout word in the stem.

teacher.key_rationale: Equal angles at an intersection are each $90^\circ$, so the lines are perpendicular. Naming only right angle, dropping the intersection condition, or choosing by the printed word equal all miss that test.
